noun_definition: netsuite refers to a cloud-based enterprise resource planning (ERP) software that is being integrated into the Expensify platform for managing accounting and custom segments/records.

rhp refers to a user interface element in the NetSuite integration that is expected to be scrollable when the "Next" button is clicked without filling in the ID in the Custom Segments/records section.

Scrollable refers to the ability of the RHP (Record Handling Panel) to allow users to move through its content vertically when the "Next" button is clicked without filling in the ID in the Custom Segments/records section.

Click refers to the action of pressing a button or interface element in the user interface, specifically the "Next" button during the process of adding custom segments or records in the NetSuite integration.
Next refers to a button in the user interface that, when clicked, is intended to proceed to the subsequent step in the process of adding custom segments or records in the application.
id refers to a required field that must be filled in the Custom Segments/records section before proceeding to the next step in the workflow.
Custom segment refers to a specific type of record that can be added and managed within the Accounting feature of the application, allowing users to define and categorize data in NetSuite.
Record refers to a specific entry or item within the Custom Segments feature in the NetSuite integration, which is intended to be added during the import process.
